items.title: Palantir Won a $127 Million Army Production Order and Still Fell 6%. Is the Valuation Finally Catching Up?
items.summary: The U.S. Army moved its Tactical Intelligence Targeting Access Node, or TITAN, into production on September 1. Palantir received a $127 million delivery order, while Anduril received $65 million. The eight initial systems are scheduled over 18 months, and the Army anticipates another order in fiscal 2027. items.title: Palantir (PLTR) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Strong Q2 And Raised Guidance
items.summary: Palantir Technologies is back in focus as fresh research lifts fair value estimates from US$185.70 to US$191.68, while price targets in recent reports cluster in a higher US$200 to US$245 range. Analysts are updating these targets after what they describe as an exceptional Q2 2026 report, stronger AI related demand, and new guidance that has split opinion on how much upside is still left. items.title: 3 Reasons PLTR Has Explosive Upside Potential
items.summary: Palantir Technologies currently trades at $182.42 and has been a dream stock for shareholders. It’s returned 583% since September 2021, blowing past the S&P 500’s 69.5% gain.
